description:
[DESTRUCTIVE] DESTRUCTIVE: deletes the queue (its drafts stay in the library). With posts booked at the platform it is refused (409) unless `unschedule: true`, which first deletes those platform posts. Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) on the Agency plan or higher. Ask the user before calling.
(Wraps DELETE /api/v2/queues/{id}.)

brandId.description: Account-wide keys: "personal" or an id from GET /api/v2/brands (omitted → the brand last active in the dashboard). A brand-bound key always uses its own brand.

unschedule.description: true: delete every booked post at the platform first (the dashboard's "Unschedule"), then delete. Without it a booked post is a 409 — nothing is ever left booked at the platform without its queue item.

name: delete_queue
title: Delete a posting queue
